criteria.evidence: verifyPathWithinRoot Lstats every component and rejects ModeSymlink; called from applyStaged before MkdirAll/WriteFile; TestVerifyPath*/TestApplyStagedRejectsSymlinkEscape pass.
verifyPathWithinRoot computes filepath.Rel(root, abs) and refuses '..' prefixes after rejecting symlinks, so the cleaned path is confined to the root; no dedicated '..' test though.
applyStaged still calls os.WriteFile unchanged after the check; no O_NOFOLLOW/O_EXCL or os.Root open was introduced.
repository.go refresh reads w.Git.RemoteURL(ctx, RemoteName) and returns an error on !git.URLsMatch(currentURL, w.URL) (fails closed); no direct gitops mismatch test but URLsMatch is tested.
EffectivePushURL/VerifyPushDestination resolve the push URL but nothing prints or reports the destination to the user; EffectivePushURL also only reads remote.origin.pushurl.
publish.go and init.go use CommitNoHooks (git commit --no-verify); TestCommitNoHooksDisablesPreCommitHooks passes.
No GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 or similar env/flag added anywhere in the diff; ExecRunner untouched.
No staged-path verification before commit; the only check is CommitPaths(ctx, "HEAD") after the commit has already been made.
After commit and before Push, CommitPaths is compared against the expected set and an error returned on any unexpected path in both publish.go and init.go; CommitPaths tests pass.
URLsMatch only strips .git and otherwise compares strings, so ports are preserved; TestURLsMatchPreservesPort (:443 vs :8443) passes.
Generic Commit() reverted to no --no-verify; a separate CommitNoHooks is used only by publish.go/init.go in the GitOps cache.
Commit/Push/Tag used by release/source remain unchanged, so user repos keep hooks; go test ./internal/release ./internal/source pass.
EffectivePushURL only reads `config --get remote.origin.pushurl`; url.*.pushInsteadOf rewrites are not resolved (no `remote get-url --push`), so such a redirect would pass unnoticed.
VerifyPushDestination returns an error (fails closed) on a detected mismatch rather than warning; no warn-only path exists.
go test ./internal/deploy ./internal/git ./internal/gitops ./internal/release ./internal/source -count=1 all ok; replay reports go vet clean on those packages.
The replay never ran go build ./... or go test ./...; only the five named packages were tested.

judge.reason: The replay implemented symlink rejection, origin verification, scoped --no-verify, port-preserving comparison and a pushurl check, but it never added no-follow opens, never disabled interactive prompting, verified paths only after commit rather than staged-before-commit, did not resolve url.*.pushInsteadOf for the effective push URL, did not report the push destination, and never ran go build/go test ./.... Several required criteria are therefore unmet, so the replay fails.
